The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8108` (see `TypesenseBuilder.TypesensePort`)
- Environment variable: `TYPESENSE_DATA_DIR=/tmp` (see `TypesenseBuilder.WithDataDirectory(string)`)
- Environment variable: `TYPESENSE_API_KEY=testcontainers` (see `TypesenseBuilder.WithApiKey(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /health` to port `8108` is completed successfully.
